about.name: Attila Utkucan
about.bio1: An independent real estate advisor rooted in Istanbul, known for his deep mastery of both the Istanbul and Bodrum markets. Attila has built his reputation on the ability to sense potential — spotting value where others see disrepair, and character where others see age. Clients trust him for his honest guidance, local knowledge, and a sharp eye for what a property could become.
about.bio2: Beyond consultancy, Attila is a hands-on developer specialised in transforming Istanbul's ageing apartment buildings into contemporary living spaces. From discovering neglected buildings in historic neighbourhoods to personally overseeing every detail of the renovation, he bridges vision and reality — delivering homes that honour their heritage while meeting modern standards.
